title: SPAR: Placement-aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Distributed Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2505.16936v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To support distributed sensing applications that require understanding of entities in the environment and their locations, this paper develops a self-supervised approach for placement-aware representation learning in spatially-distributed multi-sensor systems. The goal is to produce a latent representation of the physical environment that decouples upstream sensor placement from downstream analytics (in the sense that the pretrained encoder is reused without retraining when sensor placement changes), while supporting spatial reasoning tasks, such as joint target localization and classification, that are sensitive to sensor placement. A challenge lies in the multiplicity of sensing vantage points that collectively offer information on the shared physical environment. translated_title: SPAR：面向分布式感知的位置感知自监督表示学习
translated_abstract: 为了支持需要理解环境中实体及其位置的分布式感知应用，本文提出了一种用于空间分布式多传感器系统中位置感知表示学习的自监督方法。其目标是生成物理环境的潜在表示，将上游的传感器布设与下游分析任务解耦（即当传感器布设发生变化时，预训练的编码器无需重新训练即可复用），同时支持对传感器布设敏感的空间推理任务，例如联合目标定位与分类。其中的挑战在于多个感知观察点的多样性，它们共同提供关于共享物理环境的信息。测量结果对传感器位置的依赖性意味着潜在表示必须同时编码观测信号与观察者的观察点……
tldr: 该论文提出SPAR，一种位置感知的自监督表示学习方法，能够将传感器布设与下游分析解耦，使预训练编码器在传感器位置变化时无需重新训练即可复用，同时支持联合目标定位与分类等空间推理任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPAR, a placement-aware self-supervised representation learning approach that decouples sensor placement from downstream analytics, enabling the pretrained encoder to be reused without retraining when sensor placement changes, while supporting spatial reasoning tasks such as joint target localization and classification.
